fable_disposition.claim: Step counts across SDK reset need caution
fable_disposition.decision: Accept lifecycle uncertainty and explicit labels; mandatory at-least-two callback event counts are not established by these excerpts.

fable_disposition.claim: A physics-step subscription is the only read-only counter
fable_disposition.decision: Reject uniqueness assertion; API/event coverage requires actual proof. Do not add an unproven callback criterion solely on this recommendation.

fable_disposition.claim: cfg dt, manager dt and scene rate must be checked
fable_disposition.decision: Accept bounded readback suggestion. Installed manager already sets timeStepsPerSecond=int(1/cfg.dt) at lines598–600; there is no demonstrated 60 Hz mismatch.

fable_disposition.claim: URDF import authors drives acting in this run
fable_disposition.decision: Reject as applied to this exact proposal: it loads prepared USD, not a generic URDF import. Canonical USD has no applied DriveAPI and 18 explicit no-drive notes. Draft also checks native stiffness/damping zero. Other effective parameters still deserve recorded readback.

fable_disposition.claim: Self-collision semantics include root, joints and filtered pairs
fable_disposition.decision: Accept bounded authored/effective readback suggestion; no attribution of zero-gravity motion to a unique cause.

fable_disposition.claim: SDF view count/path/valid proves all geometry/contact fidelity
fable_disposition.decision: Not claimed or adopted. Preserve native representation-presence scope. Signed-distance/contact probes are separate later work.

fable_disposition.claim: CPU lifecycle behavior transfers to GPU
fable_disposition.decision: Not claimed or adopted. CPU source/tests prepare the fixed cuda:0 first native run; actual lifecycle/cooking remains unproven.
